THREAD-FILE-PREVIEW-001 remains user_confirmed with office conversion, editing, collaboration, and permanent storage deferred.

Thread hydration, preview grants, authenticated delivery, Markdown components, modal state, responsive layout, and client types are integrated.

Runtime supports image, PDF, text, and download-only presentation with desktop modal and mobile full-screen behavior.
